description: Require bounded comment list in multica CLI with --output json
message: multica issue comment list with --output json must be bounded: multica issue comment list <id> --roots-only --summary --compact --output json

description: Require --limit on multica issue list with --output json
message: multica issue list with --output json must include --limit <N> (e.g. --limit 15) to avoid dumping the whole backlog.
multica issue search must include --project <id> to bound search scope.

description: Protect multica daemon process from being killed by name
message: Terminating multica or multica.exe by process name is forbidden (protects the workspace daemon).
